missing: The ranking core is now production-wired (T-DEEPSEEK-98): Store::rank_with_budget computes cost_per_outcome_usd = expected task cost (cache-aware catalog pricing, VC-202-002) divided by the smoothed verified-success probability from recorded outcomes, orders floor-meeting candidates by it unless Budget::Max pins pure evidence, and keeps below-floor candidates last (VC-202-004). The production cascade (runtime.rs) and the failover order (routing.rs) consume the rank *position* — not a re-sorted score — so the leader the brain elects is what actually serves; an unfit (failed/unfunded) provider sorts behind every fit one before ranking is consulted (Mandate 56). Decisions carry evidence: Ranked serializes cpo/expected-cost/samples/success-rate through `susi brain`, and the routing ladder persists every cascade decision. The deterministic micro-benchmark now exists too (T-DEEPSEEK-99): scout_probe::SCOUT_PROBES is a fixed, bounded prompt set whose answers are checkable offline (no network, no judge model); `susi brain probe <provider>` drives it against the real configured registry through the same key arbiter as dispatch, detects flattened error text like the cascade does, and records every verified outcome into the brain evidence store. What remains undelivered: the *scheduled* scout — nothing runs the probe on a cadence, reports drift when the leader changes or a key dies, or keeps the previous ranking as evidence; and proactive candidate freshness — a model that appeared since the last scout is only probed on demand (`susi brain probe`), not discovered and probed automatically (registry membership itself is dynamic, so a retired model does stop being preferred).
